note: Pairs of articles that are lexically almost identical and legally opposite. Each case names the article that ANSWERS in `gold` and the plausible impostor in `near_miss`. The harness reports an inversion rate: how often an impostor outranks the primary gold article. Recall cannot see this failure at all — both articles are in the top 10 — but a lawyer reading top-down gets the wrong rule.

cases.query: indemnité compensatrice de préavis lorsque le salarié n'exécute pas son préavis
cases.note: Indemnité compensatrice DE PRÉAVIS versus indemnité DE LICENCIEMENT: four articles apart, both 'indemnité', both excluded by faute grave. Confusing them misstates the claim by several months of salary.

cases.query: condition d'ancienneté pour avoir droit à l'indemnité de licenciement
cases.note: The mirror of nm-001. Running both directions is what distinguishes a system that ranks correctly from one that always puts the same article of the pair first.

cases.query: délai de prescription de l'action en paiement du salaire
cases.note: Three years (L3245-1) versus two years (L1471-1), and L1471-1 explicitly carves salary claims OUT of its own rule. A ranker that puts L1471-1 first hands over the wrong limitation period.

cases.query: délai de prescription des actions portant sur l'exécution du contrat de travail
cases.note: Mirror of nm-003. The pair is the cleanest legal-consequence inversion available in this corpus.

cases.query: rupture anticipée du CDD à l'initiative du salarié
cases.note: The two articles differ by one noun ('salarié' / 'employeur') and award damages in opposite directions.

cases.query: rupture anticipée du CDD à l'initiative de l'employeur en dehors des cas autorisés
rémunération des temps de pause et de restauration à défaut d'accord collectif
cases.note: L3121-2 says when a break IS working time; L3121-6 and L3121-8 say who pays for it and under which instrument. The Code's négocié/supplétif pattern, which produces this trap systematically.

cases.query: conseiller du salarié qui assiste le salarié lors de l'entretien préalable
cases.note: Conseiller du salarié (entretien préalable, in the firm) versus défenseur syndical (before the court). Both are 'assistance', both on an administrative list, both with time credits and near-identical drafting.

cases.query: défenseur syndical assistant une partie devant la cour d'appel en matière prud'homale
indemnité de mise à la retraite due par l'employeur
cases.note: Mise à la retraite (employer's initiative, indemnity at least equal to the dismissal indemnity) versus départ à la retraite (employee's initiative, a different and smaller scale). Two articles apart.
